title: push_subscription_v1
description: A browser's request to be reminded before each deadline: the Push API subscription it holds, the language the notification speaks, and the page a tap on it opens. Sent with PUT to /api/v1/push/subscriptions on the site's host; nothing else about the visitor travels with it.

endpoint.description: The push service address the browser gave, https only.

p256dh.description: The subscription's P-256 public key, base64url without padding (65 bytes).

auth.description: The subscription's 16-byte authentication secret, base64url without padding.

league_id.description: The league the member's page is under; 0 for a team opened on its own.
